name: Helen Keller International
mission: Guided by our founder’s remarkable legacy, Helen Keller Intl works to improve the lives of people around the world by protecting vision, enhancing nutrition, and fighting disease.
theoryOfChange: Helen Keller International has a published multiyear strategy titled "Leading Locally, Fortifying Futures". This strategy outlines their approach to achieving their vision of a world where every person can live a healthy life filled with potential. It details their mission, vision, values, and core program areas, which include nutrition, vision, and health. The strategy focuses on two critical areas: improving the reach and quality of health services for underserved families and expanding access to safe, nutritious, and fortified foods. The document describes strategic choices and initiatives to deliver results in these areas.

strengths_deep_dive: Helen Keller International exhibits strong operational integrity, backed by a <cite id="1">99.5/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>. In FY2024, the organization maintained a <cite id="1">82.8% program expense ratio</cite> grounded in its score evaluation, well above the 75% industry standard. rich_narrative.summary: Helen Keller International works globally to prevent blindness and eliminate malnutrition through high-impact health programs. Founded in <cite id="1">1915</cite>, the organization maintains an established track record delivering eye care, vitamin supplements, and disease treatments. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="8">$75,653,633 in total revenue</cite>, down from <cite id="2">$145,494,796 in FY2023</cite>. Despite this revenue contraction, the organization maintains a <cite id="1">99.5/100 from Charity Navigator rating</cite> and directs a high portion of resources toward direct global health efforts. While its systemic change model creates sustainable health improvements across Africa and Asia, donors should note recent financial contractions and high fundraising expenses when excluding in-kind aid.
